prose: A Medium author built AI agents that send data-deletion requests to companies on his behalf, and reports that most companies never answered - an experiment that doubles as a measure of how broken privacy-request workflows are for automation and humans alike. The full post could not be retrieved (the fetch returned an error), so response-rate details are unavailable; this summary is based on the headline and the author's own description.
highlights: AI agents sent data-deletion requests to companies
Most companies never answered, the author reports
